detail.fitness_static: pass (exit 0) — role-migration-set.sh AC-18/22 green, grant-resolver-isolation.sh AC-20 green (frozen src/core unmodified), cross-tenant-fitness.sh green
detail.isolated_db: pass — migrations 001-016+019-021 applied twice (2nd run no-op, 19 files=19 schema_migrations rows, AC-17); negatives re-probed live: grant cross-tenant role_id -> 23503 (grant_role_id_fkey), org_scope NULL -> 23502, role_assignment composite employee/role FK -> 23503; RLS default-DENY under choros_app NOBYPASSRLS without GUC -> 0 rows on both role and role_assignment

findings.issue: Migration 021 adds grant_role_id_fkey as an immediately-VALIDATED FK (no NOT VALID), so the ALTER TABLE scans every pre-existing grant row at apply time. The ADR (1.4) verifies 'grant is EMPTY in the dev migration base' and that is accurate (008 seeds no grant data; the lone 008 'INSERT' grep hit is a GRANT DML statement). Confirmed live on a fresh isolated DB: 021 applies cleanly. LATENT HAZARD, not a code defect: any long-lived environment that accumulates grant rows whose role_id does not resolve to a seeded role BEFORE 021 runs would fail the ALTER with 23503 at promote time. Observed concretely: a parallel-branch test volume (t-0115) holds 82 grant rows with 82 distinct, non-seeded role_ids and no role table — that DB would reject 021. The canonical promote target (founder /srv/choros) is clean-replay today, so this is safe now.
findings.suggestion: Non-blocking. If a grant-write path lands before this merges to a long-lived contour, consider ADD CONSTRAINT ... NOT VALID + a separate VALIDATE CONSTRAINT after a reconciliation pass, or assert grant-empty as a pre-021 guard. The ADR seed-ordering invariant already covers future SEED rows; this finding only flags non-seed runtime rows.

findings.issue: The proposal-vs-confirmed 'confirmed_by IS NULL => zero grants' guarantee is CONTRACT-ONLY in this task, not code-enforced. Verified: grep over src/ finds no code reading role_assignment.confirmed_by; getGrants in grant-resolver.ts is an injected port with no DB body. This is exactly as the spec (FR-4, OS-1, Resolution contract) and ADR (1.3/1.5/5) declare — the confirmed+in-window filter lands in T-0053. The migration correctly enforces only the column shape (confirmed_by text NULL). Recording honestly so the orchestrator does not mistake 'columns exist' for 'proposals are inert at resolution' — the inertness is owed by T-0053.
findings.suggestion: None for T-0022. Carry the resolution-boundary filter (confirmed_by IS NOT NULL AND isEffective) as an explicit T-0053 acceptance criterion so the red-line 'no grant minted without confirmation' is actually executed.
